1.sahih_international: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."
1.pickthall: Lo! We sent Noah unto his people (saying): Warn thy people ere the painful doom come unto them.
1.yusuf_ali: We sent Noah to his People (with the Command): "Do thou warn thy People before there comes to them a grievous Penalty."
1.shakir: Surely We sent Nuh to his people, saying: Warn your people before there come upon them a painful chastisement.
1.muhammad_sarwar: We sent Noah to his people telling him, "Warn your people before a painful torment approaches them".
1.mohsin_khan: Verily, We sent Nuh (Noah) to his people (Saying): "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful torment."
1.arberry: We sent Noah to his people, saying, 'Warn thy people, ere there come on them a painful chastisement.'

2.sahih_international: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner,
2.pickthall: He said: O my people! Lo! I am a plain warner unto you
2.yusuf_ali: He said: "O my People! I am to you a Warner, clear and open:
2.shakir: He said: O my people! Surely I am a plain warner to you:
2.muhammad_sarwar: Noah said, "My people, I am warning you plainly.
2.mohsin_khan: He said: "O my people! Verily, I am a plain warner to you,
2.arberry: He said, 'O my people, I am unto you a clear warner,

3.sahih_international: [Saying], 'Worship Allah, fear Him and obey me.
3.pickthall: (Bidding you): Serve Allah and keep your duty unto Him and obey me,
3.yusuf_ali: "That ye should worship Allah, fear Him and obey me:
3.shakir: That you should serve Allah and be careful of (your duty to) Him and obey me:
3.muhammad_sarwar: Worship God, have fear of Him and obey me.
3.mohsin_khan: "That you should worship Allah (Alone), be dutiful to Him, and obey me,
3.arberry: saying, "Serve God, and fear Him, and obey you me,

4.sahih_international: Allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allah, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew.' "
4.pickthall: That He may forgive you somewhat of your sins and respite you to an appointed term. Lo! the term of Allah, when it cometh, cannot be delayed, if ye but knew.
4.yusuf_ali: "So He may forgive you your sins and give you respite for a stated Term: for when the Term given by Allah is accomplished, it cannot be put forward: if ye only knew."
4.shakir: He will forgive you some of your faults and grant you a delay to an appointed term; surely the term of Allah when it comes is not postponed; did you but know!
4.muhammad_sarwar: He will forgive your sins and give you a respite for an appointed time. When the time which God has appointed arrives, none will be able to postpone it. Would that you knew this!"
4.mohsin_khan: "He (Allah) will forgive you of your sins and respite you to an appointed term. Verily, the term of Allah when it comes, cannot be delayed, if you but knew."
4.arberry: and He will forgive you your sins, and defer you to a stated term; God's term, when it comes, cannot be deferred, did you but know."'

5.sahih_international: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.
5.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Lo! I have called unto my people night and day
5.yusuf_ali: He said: "O my Lord! I have called to my People night and day:
5.shakir: He said: O my Lord! surely I have called my people by night and by day!
5.muhammad_sarwar: Noah said, "My Lord, I have been preaching to my people, night and day,
5.mohsin_khan: He said: "O my Lord! Verily, I have called my people night and day (i.e. secretly and openly to accept the doctrine of Islamic Monotheism).
5.arberry: He said; 'My Lord, I have called my people by night and by day,

6.sahih_international: But my invitation increased them not except in flight.
6.pickthall: But all my calling doth but add to their repugnance;
6.yusuf_ali: "But my call only increases (their) flight (from the Right).
6.shakir: But my call has only made them flee the more:
6.muhammad_sarwar: but it has had no effect on them except to make them run away.
6.mohsin_khan: "But all my calling added nothing but to (their) flight (from the truth).
6.arberry: but my calling has only increased them in flight.

7.sahih_international: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.
7.pickthall: And lo! whenever I call unto them that Thou mayst pardon them they thrust their fingers in their ears and cover themselves with their garments and persist (in their refusal) and magnify themselves in pride.
7.yusuf_ali: "And every time I have called to them, that Thou mightest forgive them, they have (only) thrust their fingers into their ears, covered themselves up with their garments, grown obstinate, and given themselves up to arrogance.
7.shakir: And whenever I have called them that Thou mayest forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, cover themselves with their garments, and persist and are puffed up with pride:
7.muhammad_sarwar: Evert time I invite them to Your (guidance) so that You can forgive them, they put their fingers into their ears, cover their heads with their clothes, persist in their disbelief and display extreme arrogance.
7.mohsin_khan: "And verily! Every time I called unto them that You might forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears, covered themselves up with their garments, and persisted (in their refusal), and magnified themselves in pride.
7.arberry: And whenever I called them, that Thou mightest forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, and wrapped them in their garments, and persisted, and waxed very proud.

8.pickthall: And lo! I have called unto them aloud,
8.yusuf_ali: "So I have called to them aloud;
8.shakir: Then surely I called to them aloud:
8.muhammad_sarwar: "I preached to them aloud, in public.
8.mohsin_khan: "Then verily, I called to them openly (aloud);
8.arberry: Then indeed I called them openly;

9.sahih_international: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly
9.pickthall: And lo! I have made public proclamation unto them, and I have appealed to them in private.
9.yusuf_ali: "Further I have spoken to them in public and secretly in private,
9.shakir: Then surely I spoke to them in public and I spoke to them in secret:
9.muhammad_sarwar: Then I conveyed the message to them, again, both in public and in private,
9.mohsin_khan: "Then verily, I proclaimed to them in public, and I have appealed to them in private,
9.arberry: then indeed I spoke publicly unto them, and I spoke unto them secretly,

10.sahih_international: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.
10.pickthall: And I have said: Seek pardon of your Lord. Lo! He was ever Forgiving.
10.yusuf_ali: "Saying, 'Ask forgiveness from your Lord; for He is Oft-Forgiving;
10.shakir: Then I said, Ask forgiveness of your Lord, surely He is the most Forgiving:
10.muhammad_sarwar: and told them, "Ask forgiveness from your Lord; He is All-forgiving".
10.mohsin_khan: "I said (to them): 'Ask forgiveness from your Lord; Verily, He is Oft-Forgiving;
10.arberry: and I said, "Ask you forgiveness of your Lord; surely He is ever All-forgiving,

11.sahih_international: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
11.pickthall: He will let loose the sky for you in plenteous rain,
11.yusuf_ali: "'He will send rain to you in abundance;
11.shakir: He will send down upon you the cloud, pouring down abundance of rain:
11.mohsin_khan: 'He will send rain to you in abundance;
11.arberry: and He will loose heaven upon you in torrents

12.sahih_international: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.
12.pickthall: And will help you with wealth and sons, and will assign unto you Gardens and will assign unto you rivers.
12.yusuf_ali: "'Give you increase in wealth and sons; and bestow on you gardens and bestow on you rivers (of flowing water).
12.shakir: And help you with wealth and sons, and make for you gardens, and make for you rivers.
12.mohsin_khan: 'And give you increase in wealth and children, and bestow on you gardens and bestow on you rivers."
12.arberry: and will succour you with wealth and sons, and will appoint for you gardens, and will appoint for you rivers.

13.sahih_international: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allah [due] grandeur
13.pickthall: What aileth you that ye hope not toward Allah for dignity
13.yusuf_ali: "'What is the matter with you, that ye place not your hope for kindness and long-suffering in Allah,-
13.shakir: What is the matter with you that you fear not the greatness of Allah?
13.muhammad_sarwar: strengthen you by (providing) you wealth and children, and make gardens and streams for you. What is the matter with you that you are not afraid of the greatness of God
13.mohsin_khan: What is the matter with you, [that you fear not Allah (His punishment), and] you hope not for reward (from Allah or you believe not in His Oneness).
13.arberry: What ails you, that you look not for majesty in God,

14.sahih_international: While He has created you in stages?
14.pickthall: When He created you by (divers) stages?
14.yusuf_ali: "'Seeing that it is He that has created you in diverse stages?
14.shakir: And indeed He has created you through various grades:
14.muhammad_sarwar: who has created you in several stages?
14.mohsin_khan: While He has created you in (different) stages [i.e. first Nutfah, then 'Alaqah and then Mudghah, see (VV. 23:13, 14) the Quran].
14.arberry: seeing He created you by stages?

15.sahih_international: Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers
15.pickthall: See ye not how Allah hath created seven heavens in harmony,
15.yusuf_ali: "'See ye not how Allah has created the seven heavens one above another,
15.shakir: Do you not see how Allah has created the seven heavens, one above another,
15.muhammad_sarwar: "Have you not seen that God has created the seven heavens one above the other
15.mohsin_khan: See you not how Allah has created the seven heavens one above another,
15.arberry: Have you not regarded how God created seven heavens one upon another,

16.sahih_international: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?
16.pickthall: And hath made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp?
16.yusuf_ali: "'And made the moon a light in their midst, and made the sun as a (Glorious) Lamp?
16.shakir: And made the moon therein a light, and made the sun a lamp?
16.muhammad_sarwar: and placed therein the moon as a light
16.mohsin_khan: And has made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp?
16.arberry: and set the moon therein for a light and the sun for a lamp?

17.sahih_international: And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.
17.pickthall: And Allah hath caused you to grow as a growth from the earth,
17.yusuf_ali: "'And Allah has produced you from the earth growing (gradually),
17.shakir: And Allah has made you grow out of the earth as a growth:
17.muhammad_sarwar: and the sun as a torch.
17.mohsin_khan: And Allah has brought you forth from the (dust of) earth. [Tafsir At-Tabari, Vol. 29, Page 97].
17.arberry: And God caused you to grow out of the earth,

18.sahih_international: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.
18.pickthall: And afterward He maketh you return thereto, and He will bring you forth again, a (new) forthbringing.
18.yusuf_ali: "'And in the End He will return you into the (earth), and raise you forth (again at the Resurrection)?
18.shakir: Then He returns you to it, then will He bring you forth a (new) bringing forth:
18.muhammad_sarwar: God made you grow from the earth. He will make you return to it and then take you out of it again.
18.mohsin_khan: Afterwards He will return you into it (the earth), and bring you forth (again on the Day of Resurrection)?
18.arberry: then He shall return you into it, and bring you forth.

19.sahih_international: And Allah has made for you the earth an expanse
19.pickthall: And Allah hath made the earth a wide expanse for you
19.yusuf_ali: "'And Allah has made the earth for you as a carpet (spread out),
19.shakir: And Allah has made for you the earth a wide expanse,
19.muhammad_sarwar: God has spread out the earth
19.mohsin_khan: And Allah has made for you the earth wide spread (an expanse).
19.arberry: And God has laid the earth for you as a carpet,

20.sahih_international: That you may follow therein roads of passage.' "
20.pickthall: That ye may thread the valley-ways thereof.
20.yusuf_ali: "'That ye may go about therein, in spacious roads.'"
20.shakir: That you may go along therein in wide paths.
20.muhammad_sarwar: for you, so that you may walk along its wide roads".
20.mohsin_khan: That you may go about therein in broad roads.
20.arberry: that thereof you may thread ways, ravines."

21.sahih_international: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.
21.pickthall: Noah said: My Lord! Lo! they have disobeyed me and followed one whose wealth and children increase him in naught save ruin;
21.yusuf_ali: Noah said: "O my Lord! They have disobeyed me, but they follow (men) whose wealth and children give them no increase but only Loss.
21.shakir: Nuh said: My Lord! surely they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children have added to him nothing but loss.
21.muhammad_sarwar: Noah said, "Lord, they have disobeyed me and followed those whose wealth and children will only bring about destruction for them.
21.mohsin_khan: Nuh (Noah) said: "My Lord! They have disobeyed me, and followed one whose wealth and children give him no increase but only loss.
21.arberry: Noah said, 'My Lord, they have rebelled against me, and followed him whose wealth and children increase him only in loss,

22.sahih_international: And they conspired an immense conspiracy.
22.pickthall: And they have plotted a mighty plot,
22.yusuf_ali: "And they have devised a tremendous Plot.
22.shakir: And they have planned a very great plan.
22.muhammad_sarwar: They have arrogantly plotted evil plans against me,
22.mohsin_khan: "And they have plotted a mighty plot.
22.arberry: and have devised a mighty device

23.sahih_international: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwa' or Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr.
23.pickthall: And they have said: Forsake not your gods. Forsake not Wadd, nor Suwa', nor Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr.
23.yusuf_ali: "And they have said (to each other), 'Abandon not your gods: Abandon neither Wadd nor Suwa', neither Yaguth nor Ya'uq, nor Nasr';-
23.shakir: And they say: By no means leave your gods, nor leave Wadd, nor Suwa; nor Yaghus, and Yauq and Nasr.
23.muhammad_sarwar: and have said to each other, 'Do not give-up your idols. Do not renounce Wadd, Suwa`, Yaghuth, Ya`uq and Nasr (names of certain idols).
23.mohsin_khan: "And they have said: 'You shall not leave your gods, nor shall you leave Wadd, nor Suwa', nor Yaghuth, nor Ya'uq, nor Nasr (names of the idols);
23.arberry: and have said, "Do not leave your gods, and do not leave Wadd, nor Suwa', Yaghuth, Ya'uq, neither Nasr."

24.sahih_international: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."
24.pickthall: And they have led many astray, and Thou increasest the wrong-doers in naught save error.
24.yusuf_ali: "They have already misled many; and grant Thou no increase to the wrong-doers but in straying (from their mark)."
24.shakir: And indeed they have led astray many, and do not increase the unjust in aught but error.
24.muhammad_sarwar: They have misled many and the unjust will achieve nothing but more error".
24.mohsin_khan: "And indeed they have led many astray. And (O Allah): 'Grant no increase to the Zalimun (polytheists, wrong-doers, and disbelievers, etc.) save error."
24.arberry: And they have led many astray. Increase Thou not the evildoers save in error!'

25.sahih_international: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allah [any] helpers.
25.pickthall: Because of their sins they were drowned, then made to enter a Fire. And they found they had no helpers in place of Allah.
25.yusuf_ali: Because of their sins they were drowned (in the flood), and were made to enter the Fire (of Punishment): and they found- in lieu of Allah- none to help them.
25.shakir: Because of their wrongs they were drowned, then made to enter fire, so they did not find any helpers besides Allah.
25.muhammad_sarwar: Because of their sins, they were drowned and made to enter hell. They could find no one to help them besides God.
25.mohsin_khan: Because of their sins they were drowned, then were made to enter the Fire, and they found none to help them instead of Allah.
25.arberry: And because of their transgressions they were drowned, and admitted into a Fire, for they found not, apart from God, any to help them.

26.sahih_international: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.
26.pickthall: And Noah said: My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers in the land.
26.yusuf_ali: And Noah, said: "O my Lord! Leave not of the Unbelievers, a single one on earth!
26.shakir: And Nuh said: My Lord! leave not upon the land any dweller from among the unbelievers:
26.muhammad_sarwar: Noah said, "Lord, do not leave a single disbeliever on earth;
26.mohsin_khan: And Nuh (Noah) said: "My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers on the earth!
26.arberry: And Noah said, 'My Lord, leave not upon the earth of the unbelievers even one.

27.sahih_international: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.
27.pickthall: If Thou shouldst leave them, they will mislead Thy slaves and will beget none save lewd ingrates.
27.yusuf_ali: "For, if Thou dost leave (any of) them, they will but mislead Thy devotees, and they will breed none but wicked ungrateful ones.
27.shakir: For surely if Thou leave them they will lead astray Thy servants, and will not beget any but immoral, ungrateful (children)
27.muhammad_sarwar: if You do, they will mislead Your servants and will only give birth to ungrateful sinners.
27.mohsin_khan: "If You leave them, they will mislead Your slaves, and they will beget none but wicked disbelievers."
27.arberry: Surely, if Thou leavest them, they will lead Thy servants astray, and will beget none but unbelieving libertines.

28.sahih_international: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."
28.pickthall: My Lord! Forgive me and my parents and him who entereth my house believing, and believing men and believing women, and increase not the wrong-doers in aught save ruin.
28.yusuf_ali: "O my Lord! Forgive me, my parents, all who enter my house in Faith, and (all) believing men and believing women: and to the wrong-doers grant Thou no increase but in perdition!"
28.shakir: My Lord! forgive me and my parents and him who enters my house believing, and the believing men and the believing women; and do not increase the unjust in aught but destruction!
28.muhammad_sarwar: Lord, forgive me, my parents, the believers who have entered my home and all believing men and women. Give nothing to the unjust but destruction.
28.mohsin_khan: "My Lord! Forgive me, and my parents, and him who enters my home as a believer, and all the believing men and women. And to the Zalimun (polytheists, wrong-doers, and disbelievers, etc.) grant You no increase but destruction!"
28.arberry: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whosoever enters my house as a believer, and the believers, men and women alike; and do Thou not increase the evildoers save in ruin!'
